Product Features

  • Size: This TV cabinet with a unique combination of white and grey forms a filigree frame of 180 x 40 x 46.5cm. Its stylish and elegant appearance integrates perfectly with a variety of interior styles, such as Nordic style and modern minimalist style, and can easily become the visual focal point in the living room.
  • Load-bearing: It is an ideal companion, tailor-made for 60/65/70-inch TVs. After careful design and structural optimization, the total load capacity is up to 30 kg. Like a solid and reliable protection, it can keep the TV stable without it being able to withstand the stresses of time.
  • Tempered glass partition: The tempered glass partition in the middle is not only a practical storage surface, but also gives the TV cabinet a flexible and convertible soul. Its adjustment function is like a moody fashion expert. The height can be easily adjusted to the different sizes and requirements of the objects being placed. Whether large audio devices or small decorative objects, everyone will find a suitable place here.
  • Three-layer design: The unique three-layer design resembles a well-planned city block, with each layer having a clear functional division. The top layer can be used to place exquisite decorations, the middle layer can be used to place frequently used electronic devices, and the bottom layer is used to store small items. The transparent layers are both beautiful and practical, enriching the appearance
  • Large storage space: 4 cabinets with opening doors, two of them with unique L-shaped doors. The L-shaped door breaks the monotony of traditional cabinet doors. With its unique geometric shape, it gives the TV cabinet a touch of fashion and three-dimensionality, like putting a trendy coat on the cabinet. Every time it is opened, it can unfold its unique charm.
  • Unique design: Clever combination of open and closed storage space. The open space can be used to place frequently used electronic devices for easy operation and use. The closed cabinets can be used to store books, decorative items and other items. Dust is effectively kept out, so the living room is no longer cluttered and always remains neat and tidy.
  • Silent hinge: The use of a silent hinge adds the finishing touch. When opening and closing the cabinet door, it moves smoothly and smoothly like an elegant gentleman, silently and without disturbing noises. Whether you get up early in the morning to look for something or take something with you or put something away late at night, it doesn't disturb your family's peace of mind and creates a warm and quiet atmosphere at home.
  • LED light strips: The mobile phone app controls the LED lights and thus creates a great atmosphere. When watching a movie, adjust the warm yellow ambient light to experience the drama more intensely. Switch to coloured light strips at your party and the TV wall becomes an "atmosphere wall". It is extremely flexible and can be adapted to different scenes.
  • Practicality: It is not only a cabinet for placing the TV, but also an important household item that enhances the style of the living room. It is based on practical functions and has a fashionable design as a wing. It adds quality and comfort to your life and becomes an indispensable and warm presence in your home.
  • Note: This product consists of two packages and may not arrive at the same time. Please make sure both packages have arrived before you start assembling!

Descriptions

Description

Measuring 180 x 40 x 50 cm, this modern TV cabinet has a contrasting white and grey design and is perfect for 60-70" TVs (load capacity 30 kg). The innovative three-layer layout with adjustable tempered glass dividers allows for scientific subdivision of decorations, electronic equipment and sundries. The combination of 4 cabinet doors (including 2 stylish L-doors) and open compartment ensures both dust-protected storage and convenient access. Noiseless hinges ensure silent opening and closing, and the special surface material can be cleaned with just one wipe. The product will be shipped in two packages.
